raw_segments.text: Kalia was already by Alush's bedside. The sick boy turned visibly paler. He raised
himself in the bed and looked intently at Kalia. Kalia had not seen his little friend
for two months, and he was overwhelmed at the sight of him. He had never imagined that
he would see such a wasted, yellow face, such enormous, feverishly glowing eyes and such
thin little hands. He saw, with grieved surprise, Alush's rapid, hard breathing and dry lips.
He stepped close to him, held out his hand, and almost overwhelmed, he said.
